title: Song of Solomon Bible Quiz - Chapter 3
description: Ten questions on Song of Solomon 3: seeking the beloved by night, the watchmen of the city, and Solomon's carriage of the wood of Lebanon.

questions.text: What happened when the speaker sought on her bed by night him whom her soul loves?
questions.explanation: She says, "By night on my bed, I sought him whom my soul loves. I sought him, but I didn't find him."

answers.text: He was waiting at her door
He called to her from the street
She sought him, but didn't find him
She fell asleep and dreamed of him

questions.text: Where in the city did the speaker say she would seek her beloved?
questions.explanation: She says, "I will get up now, and go about the city; in the streets and in the squares I will seek him whom my soul loves."

answers.text: In the streets and in the squares
At the city gates and towers

questions.text: What did the speaker ask the watchmen who go about the city?
questions.explanation: The watchmen found her, and she asked, "Have you seen him whom my soul loves?"

answers.text: "Where is the house of the king?"
"Is it yet night in the city?"
"Have you seen him whom my soul loves?"

questions.text: Where did the speaker bring her beloved after she found him and held him?
questions.explanation: She held him and would not let him go until she had brought him into her mother's house, into the room of her who conceived her.

answers.text: Into the vineyard of En Gedi

questions.text: What comes up from the wilderness like pillars of smoke?
questions.explanation: The chapter asks who this is who comes up from the wilderness like pillars of smoke, perfumed with myrrh and frankincense, and answers: behold, it is Solomon's carriage.

questions.text: How many mighty men are around Solomon's carriage?
questions.explanation: Sixty mighty men are around it, of the mighty men of Israel.

questions.text: Why does every man around the carriage have his sword on his thigh?
questions.explanation: They all handle the sword and are expert in war; every man has his sword on his thigh because of fear in the night.

answers.text: Because of fear in the night
Because of robbers in the wilderness
Because of the day of battle

questions.text: Of what wood did king Solomon make himself a carriage?
questions.explanation: King Solomon made himself a carriage of the wood of Lebanon.

answers.text: The wood of the apple tree
The wood of the nut tree grove

questions.text: Of what did Solomon make the pillars of his carriage?
questions.explanation: He made its pillars of silver, its bottom of gold, and its seat of purple.

questions.text: With what are the daughters of Zion told to see king Solomon on the day of his weddings?
questions.explanation: They are told to go out and see king Solomon with the crown with which his mother has crowned him, in the day of his weddings.

answers.text: The sword of the sixty mighty men of Israel
The royal robe that his father has given him
The banner of love that is spread over him
The crown with which his mother has crowned him
